summary: PROVEN (documented): alpine-based images use musl libc (postgres:17-alpine, node:*-alpine, gateway). No glibc-dependent native modules observed in the gateway image (sharp is a repo dependency but is NOT installed in the image - verified 'Cannot find module'). musl is therefore the only libc in play. Applies to 'node:20-alpine @ sha256:fb4cd12c85ee03686f6af5362a0b0d5'.
